{{Top}}
{{Quote|Obviously, we've got another bad transmitter|Pol Treidum|<ref name="sw73">[[Star Wars (1977) 3|''Star Wars'' (1977) 3]]</ref>}}
The term '''transmitter''' referred to any device used to relay data and information. Several specific types of transmitters included the [[crystal transmitter]] employed by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Danu]], [[Holotransmitter/Legends|holo-transmitters]] that beamed transmissions using known communication frequencies, [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transmitters]] designed to send ultra-fast messages through hyperspace, [[mini-transmitter]]s used to communicate with others while altering a person's natural voice, and [[sub-space image transmitter]]s that utilized [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] technology.

Other communication devices could also send transmissions. These included [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomms]] or [[villip]]s.

An array of transmitters was installed onto the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ships]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. These sent signals that remotely controlled [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] deployed by the Trade Federation and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]].<ref name="SWE Trade Federation battleship">{{SWE|technology|tradefederationbattleship|Trade Federation battleship}}</ref>
